source: Reference answers from Claude Opus 5.5 (medium effort), answered blind. Each case was given exactly the system prompt, user message and output schema the gateway sends to a Messages API upstream (captured from the gateway at 75eed5c), then mapped back through the gateway itself (normalization, choice, score, confidence, 2-decimal rounding). The without_user_instructions answers come from a separate agent that never saw the user_instructions variant.

reasons.handling_mode: Objective is routing, so passing the case to a team queue fits best; a direct decision is plausible because the case is simple.
reasons.staff_effort: Unopened item, has receipt, inside the window: routine.

reasons.handling_mode: No objective supplied; a clear in-policy return favors a direct decision, with some mass on queue routing.
reasons.staff_effort: Unopened item, receipt, well within window: routine.

ui_dependence: The objective field in user_instructions is the only thing that tells the model which kind of output the team wants; without it the three options are equally plausible.
